page.overview:
Who is Brittany?

is the second main character in Together Forever, the third story of Fazbear Frights 10: Friendly Face.

Brittany and Jessica are considered the prettiest girls in their class. Brittany has nails painted purple with gold swirls, shiny blonde hair, big bright blue eyes, high cheekbones, a pert nose, full lips, a perfect petite figure, and the most up-to-date fashions and makeup like lip gloss. For most of the story, she wears a chocolate-brown faux suede miniskirt with two diagonal zippers forming a V in the front, a flouncy chocolate-and-black geometric-patterned blouse, and black platforms. When working on Rosie Porkchop, she changes to denim.
